model: 1K6F assembly1 collagen mimetic (Pro-Pro-Gly) trimer; modeled29 residues per chain, not native fish collagen
restraints: none; free charged termini; HBonds constraints and rigid water only
parameter_basis: assumed demonstration conditions, not paper reproduction: ff14SB family supported by Hartmann2021 Methods; water TIP3P differs from that paper OPC; no H mass repartitioning;1fs rather than4fs; short100ps production rather than1us; folded starting state and no nucleus restraint
interpretation: No claim of equilibrated ensemble, folding kinetics, collagen modulus, empirical accuracy or fish tissue function. Replicates share one structure/forcefield and are dependent evidence.
